about.subtitle: Full-Stack Developer. Based in Portugal.
about.bio_1: I'm a Full-Stack Developer with 5+ years of experience building Laravel APIs, Vue.js and Nuxt.js frontends, and marketing automation systems. Based in Portugal, open to relocation across Europe.
about.bio_2: I write code with an eye for clean, maintainable systems, but I'm also pragmatic about tools and shortcuts. I gravitate towards Laravel on the backend and Vue/Nuxt on the frontend, and I've worked across enough stacks to know that the right tool matters less than a solid architecture and clear abstractions.
about.bio_3: I'm available for senior fullstack roles and freelance projects across Europe. If you're building something with Vue, Nuxt, or Laravel and need someone who ships, let's talk.
about.quote: Ship things that matter. Delete everything else.

dev.label: Portfolio
dev.subtitle: Production projects. Each solves a real problem.
dev.seo_description: Fullstack portfolio in production. DevStats and LeadFlow — Laravel, Nuxt 4, Vue.js, TypeScript, Redis and WebSocket.

devstats.description: Personal dashboard that aggregates GitHub, Linear and Toggl activity on a single screen. Eliminates daily standup overhead by automatically generating a draft with open PRs, in-progress issues and logged hours — all in real time via WebSocket.
highlights: Event-driven with Redis queues for async ingestion from all three providers
WebSocket (Laravel Reverb) for real-time updates without polling
OAuth 2.0 with GitHub, Linear and Toggl — complete authorisation flow
Automatic standup: generates a daily draft with active cycle context

leadflow.description: Marketing automation platform built on Event-Driven Architecture. Solves the problem of unprioritised leads: each lead is ingested, scored atomically via Redis, and the dashboard updates in real time as events arrive.
highlights: Atomic lead scoring with Redis — no race conditions under parallel ingestion
Real-time dashboard with WebSocket, zero manual reload
Configurable automation pipeline: triggers, conditions and actions
Event-oriented architecture — every action is a persisted event
